note: Written by the developers, not real AI answers or real papers. 'dev' was used to set the rules; 'heldout' was written at the same time, before any run, and is only scored, never used to change a rule.

dev.claim: 空间滤波应放在分类之前。
dev.source: 综述指出，空间滤波应在分类之后进行。

dev.claim: 共平均参考会提高脑电信号的信噪比。
dev.source: 共平均参考会降低脑电信号的信噪比。

dev.claim: 心率变异性随年龄增长而升高。
dev.source: 心率变异性随年龄增长而下降。

dev.claim: 肌电信号的采样率需要高于 1000 Hz。
dev.source: 肌电信号的采样率不需要高于 1000 Hz。

dev.claim: Batch normalization reduces overfitting in small EEG datasets.
dev.source: Batch normalization increases overfitting in small EEG datasets.

dev.claim: Independent component analysis should be applied before epoching.
dev.source: Independent component analysis should be applied after epoching.

dev.claim: 线性判别分析适合高维小样本数据。
dev.source: 线性判别分析不适合高维小样本数据。

dev.claim: Higher electrode impedance increases noise in the recording.
dev.source: Higher electrode impedance does not increase noise in the recording.

dev.claim: 去趋势处理应在滤波之后进行。
dev.source: 去趋势处理应在滤波之前进行。

dev.claim: The P300 amplitude is positively correlated with attention.
dev.source: The P300 amplitude is negatively correlated with attention.

dev.claim: 空间滤波应放在分类之前。
dev.source: 空间滤波可能需要放在分类之后。

dev.claim: 共平均参考会提高信噪比。
dev.source: 本研究使用了 64 导联的电极帽。

dev.claim: 心率变异性随年龄增长而升高。
dev.source: 心率变异性随年龄增长而升高，这与以往研究一致。

dev.claim: 小波去噪不会增加信号失真。
dev.source: 小波去噪降低信号失真。

dev.claim: 不同受试者的脑电差异很大。
dev.source: 不同受试者的脑电差异很大。

dev.claim: Notch filtering at 50 Hz removes power-line noise.
dev.source: Notch filtering at 50 Hz may not remove all power-line noise.

dev.claim: Deep learning outperforms LDA on large datasets.
dev.source: Deep learning outperforms LDA on large datasets but not on small ones.

dev.claim: 采样率越高越好。
dev.source: 采样率越高，数据量越大。

dev.claim: Common average reference improves SNR.
dev.source: Common average reference does not improve classification accuracy.

dev.claim: 脑电的 alpha 波在闭眼时增强。
dev.source: 脑电的 alpha 波在闭眼时增强，在睁眼时减弱。

heldout.claim: 独立成分分析可以去除眼电伪迹。
heldout.source: 独立成分分析不能去除眼电伪迹。

heldout.claim: Downsampling should be done before filtering.
heldout.source: Downsampling should be done after filtering.

heldout.claim: 运动想象会增强对侧运动皮层的 mu 节律。
heldout.source: 运动想象会减弱对侧运动皮层的 mu 节律。

heldout.claim: Increasing the window length improves classification accuracy.
heldout.source: Increasing the window length reduces classification accuracy.

heldout.claim: 皮肤电导在情绪唤醒时上升。
heldout.source: 皮肤电导在情绪唤醒时没有上升。

heldout.claim: Cross-validation folds must be split by subject.
heldout.source: Cross-validation folds need not be split by subject.

heldout.claim: 血氧饱和度低于 90% 属于正常范围。
heldout.source: 血氧饱和度低于 90% 不属于正常范围。

heldout.claim: Artifact rejection should precede ICA.
heldout.source: Artifact rejection should follow ICA.

heldout.claim: 高通滤波会降低基线漂移。
heldout.source: 高通滤波会增加基线漂移。

heldout.claim: Z-score normalization is not needed for tree-based models.
heldout.source: Z-score normalization is needed for tree-based models.

heldout.claim: 高通滤波会降低基线漂移。
heldout.source: 高通滤波或许会降低基线漂移。

heldout.claim: 采样率应不低于 250 Hz。
heldout.source: 采样率应不低于 250 Hz，以保留 gamma 频段。

heldout.claim: Dropout reduces overfitting.
heldout.source: Dropout reduces overfitting, but it does not fix label noise.

heldout.claim: 运动想象会增强对侧运动皮层的 mu 节律。
heldout.source: 运动想象时被试需要保持身体不动。

heldout.claim: ICA should be applied before epoching.
heldout.source: ICA was applied before epoching in all subjects.

heldout.claim: 共平均参考提高信噪比。
heldout.source: 共平均参考不仅提高信噪比，也减少了参考电极的偏差。

heldout.claim: Larger batch sizes speed up training.
heldout.source: Larger batch sizes might slow down training.

heldout.claim: 心电 R 峰检测常用 Pan-Tompkins 算法。
heldout.source: 心电 R 峰检测的 Pan-Tompkins 算法并非唯一选择。

heldout.claim: The model is not suitable for real-time use.
heldout.source: The model is not suitable for real-time use on phones.

heldout.claim: 深度学习需要大量标注数据。
heldout.source: 深度学习需要大量标注数据吗？这一问题仍有争议。
